items.title: Housing price downturn accelerates as 'perfect storm' hits market
items.description: Australian home values record their biggest decline in more than three years as the housing market slowdown that began in Sydney and Melbourne spreads across the country.

items.title: Live: 'Alarming': PM questions why Ernst and Young grads had access to banking data
items.description: Anthony Albanese has questioned how two Ernst and Young graduates had access to personal banking data after one was charged with accessing his account. Follow live.

items.title: Breaking: ACCC knocks back Coles supermarket as consumer watchdog flexes new powers
items.description: In an unprecedented move, Australia's consumer watchdog has exercised new powers to block the opening of a Coles supermarket, on the grounds it could knock out smaller competitors in the surrounding region.

items.title: Coalition avoids direct One Nation messaging in daily talking points
items.description: Coalition talking points, obtained by the ABC, make almost no direct mention of One Nation despite the minor party surging in the polls.

items.title: Australian rising star takes down Serena Williams in Wimbledon return
items.description: Australian Maya Joint holds her nerve to beat tennis legend Serena Williams in the 23-time grand slam champion's first professional tennis match in four years.

items.title: Photos show room where police allege Australian man murdered Thai teenager
items.description: New photographs reveal the cluttered room where 17-year-old Tunchanok Donhomla was allegedly murdered by Australian man Simon Peter Carman.

items.title: Harmful conspiracy sustained anti-Jewish hate online, commission hears
items.description: The royal commission has heard new research which found anti-Jewish hate increased online both after October 7, 2023 and the Bondi Beach terror attack in December.

items.title: New financial year, new rules and how today's changes affect your wallet
items.description: A bunch of new rules come into effect today. Find out how they could impact your finances.

items.title: Live: France's fantastic four puts on a show to dismantle Sweden
items.description: Kylian Mbappé scores twice for France as it tears Sweden apart, while Erling Haaland nets an 88th minute winner to send Norway through and eliminate Côte d'Ivoire. Follow live.

items.title: US Supreme Court rejects Trump's bid to end birthright citizenship
items.description: Donald Trump's controversial attempt to restrict birthright citizenship in the US is rejected by the Supreme Court, up-ending the president's hardline agenda on immigration.

items.title: Venezuelan earthquake rescuers save 3yo boy after six days under rubble
items.description: The death toll from Venezuela's devastating two earthquakes has risen to more than 1,900, as tens of thousands of people still remain unaccounted.

items.title: One of the best movies of 2026 cost less than $1 million
items.description: It's officially halfway through 2026 and the year so far has brought cinematic delights, as well as its fair share of silver screen stinkers. Here are our critics' top picks.

items.title: 'Fear and panic' as more NDIS registration rules loom
items.description: Uncertainty and confusion are sweeping across the NDIS provider sector with mandatory registration for two categories of providers starting today.

items.title: Live: ASX likely to open higher, AI-buying frenzy drives Dow to record high
items.description: The Australian share market is likely to have a cautious start to the new financial year, while an AI stock-led rally boosted the Dow Jones to a record high for a second straight day. Follow live.

items.title: Certain sports have a high risk of brain injury. What can you do as a parent?
items.description: When your child decides they are keen on playing sport, there are lots of factors to consider as a parent, and after recent news stories about chronic traumatic encephalopathy, keeping them safe from head injuries may be front of mind.

items.title: Do you have what it takes to best our travel quiz?
items.description: Where would you find the iconic Forrest Gump bench? And do you know where this bridge is?

items.title: The condition that causes people to get lost in their own home
items.description: Some estimates suggest up to one in 30 people may be affected by a condition that has been described as a lifelong inability to orient oneself — even in extremely familiar surroundings.

items.title: Scientists prepare natural enemy to fight one of Australia's worst weeds
items.description: An imported plant pathogen that will spread on the wind is being readied for release against one of Australia's worst weeds.

items.title: The tension between a healing mental therapy and victims seeking justice
items.description: Victim-survivors of alleged sexual abuse have spoken to the ABC of the tension between EMDR mental health therapy and seeking justice through the legal system.

items.title: Volunteers say National Trust of SA warned them against speaking publicly
items.description: Volunteers who spoke to the media say they felt "threatened" with formal warnings from the National Trust of South Australia. They are now preparing to share their experiences in a parliamentary inquiry.

items.title: One dead, two fighting for life after suspicious Gold Coast house fire
items.description: A man has died in a suspicious Gold Coast fire that's also left two people with life-threatening burns and another with non-life-threatening injuries.

items.title: Renewed push to ban 'conversion practices' in Tasmania
items.description: Tasmania was the last Australian jurisdiction to decriminalise homosexuality, but since then it has gone on to pass some of the country's most inclusive legislation. There's one final frontier — conversion practices.

items.title: Three people evacuated from suspicious blaze on busy Melbourne road
items.description: A fire that engulfed a tobacco shop on Bridge Road in Richmond early this morning is being treated as suspicious.

items.title: Showcase of electric mine trucks signals long road still ahead
items.description: BHP and Rio Tinto have put their two battery-electric trucks on show, but is an aversion to risk stifling meaningful change?

items.title: 'Not fair and honest': Accounting firms face split after KPMG scandal
items.description: Accounting firms could be asked to split their lucrative consulting services from their audit functions and individual firm partners could face far greater scrutiny and penalties for legal breaches, under a shake up of the industry being consulted on by the federal government.
